questions.q: What did Black Beauty do while her mother worked in the daytime?
choices: stand by the pond in the shade
gallop all together round and round the field
questions.explain: Black Beauty lay close by her mother's side when it was cold.

questions.q: Which of these activities did Black Beauty NOT do with her mother and brothers in the meadow?
choices: gallop all together round and round the field
questions.explain: Black Beauty stood by the pond in the shade of the trees with her mother.

questions.q: What did Black Beauty's mother teach her important lesson about the colts in the meadow?
choices: to pay attention and be gentle
questions.explain: Black Beauty's mother wanted her to learn to be careful and gentle around the colts.

questions.q: What did the colts in the meadow do when they were older?
choices: Play rough and kick each other
Stay in the meadow all day
Eat grass and rest all day
Run around the field as hard as they could
questions.explain: The colts in the meadow played together but sometimes had rough play.

questions.q: Why did Black Beauty stand in the pond on a hot day?
choices: To cool off in the water
questions.explain: Black Beauty stood in the pond on a hot day to cool off in the water.

questions.q: What did Black Beauty's mother do for a living when she wasn't with the colts?
questions.explain: Black Beauty's mother went out to work in the fields when she wasn't with the colts.
